checks.target: Application form inputs rendered for customers (views.py dashboard)
checks.required_behavior: Form collects only purpose-relevant inputs: email (delivery), amount and term (offer), income band (assessment); no hobby or other non-purpose field.
checks.observed_code_behavior: The customer dashboard builds fields from notice() plus inputbox email, inputbox amount, select term [6,12,24,36], select income [low,medium,high], and an 'auto' checkbox. No hobby or other non-purpose input is rendered.

anchors.explanation: Renders exactly email, amount, term, income and the auto route checkbox; no hobby field.

checks.required_behavior: Server rejects any application field outside the necessary set {email, amount, term, income, auto}.
checks.observed_code_behavior: submit enforces set(data) <= {email, amount, term, income, auto} and raises 'Unexpected application field.' otherwise; app.py parses the form into data and forwards it to store.submit.

anchors.explanation: Allowlist rejects any field outside the necessary set, including a hobby.
Form payload parsed into data without synthesizing extra fields.
Route /apply forwards data to store.submit, the sole application persistence path.

checks.target: Persistence of application fields (cases table insert and summary)
checks.required_behavior: Only purpose-relevant fields are persisted; no hobby or other non-purpose field stored.
checks.observed_code_behavior: Schema columns are email, amount, term, income, route, stage (plus owner/officer/confirmed/restricted); INSERT writes owner, officer, email, amount, term, income, route, stage; summary title uses amount and term only.

anchors.explanation: Schema has no hobby or other non-purpose column.
Insert and summary write only purpose-relevant values.

checks.target: Onward payloads: offer, portable, transfer to receiver
checks.required_behavior: Data sent onward is limited to purpose-relevant fields (email, amount, term, income).
checks.observed_code_behavior: offer() returns case id, email, amount, term; portable() returns email, amount, term, income; transfer stores json.dumps(portable(c)) in receiver. No hobby or other non-purpose field is included.

anchors.explanation: offer and portable payloads contain only purpose-relevant fields.
Transfer persists the portable payload (email, amount, term, income) only.

output.summary: The customer form (views.py 31-32) renders only email, amount, term, income and the 'auto' route checkbox; no hobby or other non-purpose input. The /apply payload is parsed (app.py 53-55) and forwarded to store.submit (app.py 83-84), which enforces a field allowlist {email, amount, term, income, auto} (store.py 67), validates amount/term/income (69-74), and persists only purpose-relevant columns (store.py 36-38, 77-79). Onward payloads — offer (111-112), portable (114-116) and transfer to receiver (201-203) — carry only email, amount, term, income. No non-purpose field appears in the form, allowlist, schema, persistence or onward sending, so the minimization predicate holds across all in-scope targets.
